amended: 2026-07-12 (v0.2.0: cookbook taxonomy expanded to full inventory by human direction — structural ladder + nine elemental classes)

cookbook._note: The reticulation taxonomy. Every atom in the corpus binds to exactly one structural tier (if it renders) and one elemental class (always). Expanding this taxonomy is a human act.

structural_ladder.organisms: src/organisms/ (5: Home, CompassForm, ResultView, Brief, ReflectLayer)
structural_ladder.templates: src/document/patterns/ (10) + src/document/screens/ (5) + public/templates/ (1) + src/emails/ (4) + ui-kit assembly (1)

elemental_ladder.invariants: 5 ROM primitives + operational law (inline-styles, JSON-as-TEXT, no unasked deps, append-only handoffs, honest gauges)
elemental_ladder.primitives: DEWY vector, ARCS Law, CoherenceSignal/Receipt, FATEDReasoning, AxiomCheck, SomaticReading, Y-gate manifold
elemental_ladder.protocols: hyperstition, accumulation, shared court, recoil, handoff, collision-escalation, two-surface
elemental_ladder.operators: operators/*.py — LAB, BAR, SAGE, CURATOR, KAIROS, CONTRACT, OPERATOR20, KINTSUGI + systems + infra
elemental_ladder.advisors: Loki, Advisors, Bayesian, dual Bar Raiser, Curator, Fun House Mirror, DRIFT Sentinel, Kairos, The Alchemist
elemental_ladder.risks: No-Go Inventory v1.0 (BSS_WALL, TRIUNE_REMAINDER, KINTSUGI_SCAR, STRUCTURAL_BLIND) + live BAR register + standing redaction law
elemental_ladder.patterns: _PATTERNS/*.md — minted from post-mortems, cited by roadmaps, never silently edited
elemental_ladder.archetypes: scripts/arcs_core.py ARCHETYPES — Builder, Navigator, Illuminator, Instrumentor, Mediator, Orienter, Chartist, Focused Executor; UNDEFINED never force-classified

governing_canon: WORLD.md (render law: fidelity is earned, not dialed)
purpose: Overnight batch routine that progressively enriches the internally-facing corpus registries (meta-audit artifact, its git twin, drift ledger, parity matrix, epoch timeline) so drift stops accumulating between human audits. ARCS building ARCS — as proposal, never as ratification.

constitutional_invariants.notomation: The Alchemist scaffolds and sequences; it never compresses, replaces, or overrules revealed preference. It PROPOSES on a branch; a human RATIFIES at dawn. No exceptions.
may_never: edit canon (_CANON/) or ordinals (mint-don't-edit; collisions escalate per canon-collision law)
resolve a CANON_COLLISION or ADR numbering collision unilaterally
close a drift-ledger item without a commit SHA to cite as evidence
inflate a gauge or drop a tilde from an assessed value
invent a new cookbook tier or element class (see cookbook block) — escalate instead
tune its own constants (self-tuning FORBIDDEN — same law as lattice-pressure ROM; constants change only by human commit)
add dependencies, deploy, or touch production infrastructure
run when the kill switch file is absent

kill_switch.law: File absent => the routine exits immediately with a no-op receipt. Creating or deleting this file is a human act. Ships DISABLED.

phases.name: SCAN
phases.does: git log/diff since the epoch SHA stamped in _STATE/meta-audit-roadmap-v1.md; recount L0 atoms (canon docs, ADRs, operators, scripts, specs, src, routes, pages, models, briefs, patterns, shards, ordinals, RCs, tests); verify registry-vs-tree integrity (_DECISIONS/index.json vs files, RC-REGISTRY vs operators/, ordinals chain vs _CANON/ordinals/, artifact twin exists).

phases.name: RETICULATE
phases.does: Bind every new/changed atom to its cookbook coordinates — one structural tier (atoms/molecules/organisms/templates/pages, if it renders) and one elemental class (ordinals/invariants/primitives/protocols/operators/advisors/risks/patterns/archetypes) — plus its organ; run invariant tripwire greps (className/Tailwind outside sanctioned files, package.json dep additions, Prisma Json type, commit-format conformance); flag unbindable atoms as drift candidates.

phases.name: ENRICH
phases.does: Re-grade parity matrix rows touched by the diff; append/close drift-ledger entries with file:line or SHA evidence; propose epoch-timeline candidates (kairos flag only with justification); recompute assessed gauges (done-state, governed lines) with tildes intact.

phases.name: PROPOSE
phases.does: Write updated twin (_STATE/meta-audit-roadmap-v1.md) + regenerated artifact HTML + inchworm entry marked PROPOSED to branch alchemist/YYYY-MM-DD (fresh worktree off main; never deploys; artifact redeploy is staged as a payload path, executed only after human ratification).

phases.name: RECEIPT
phases.does: DEWY-stamped morning brief: what changed, what drifted, what needs the human, ranked by consequence — even when the answer is 'nothing' (heartbeat receipt). Written to _STATE/alchemist-briefs/YYYY-MM-DD.md on the proposal branch.

controls._note: The interactive dials of the meta-audit artifact are the routine's tempo controls. Humans set them here; the routine reads them. It may not write this block.

black_point.meaning: noise floor: findings scoring below this consequence threshold are logged in the branch but excluded from the morning brief

range: twin + artifact page + snapshot mechanical refresh
resolution.meaning: re-render scope of the PROPOSE phase

tempo.meaning: cron cadence; overnight to batch token spend away from working hours

token_ceiling_per_run.value: hard stop at budget; on breach: halt, file partial receipt marked TRUNCATED, never silently trim findings

outputs: regenerated meta-audit artifact HTML (redeploy staged, human-gated)

ratification.how: review morning brief -> merge branch (ratify), amend then merge (correct), or delete branch (reject). Artifact redeploys only after merge.
ratification.record: ratified inchworm entries drop the PROPOSED marker via the merge commit

amendment_law: This ROM is versioned per repo spec policy: front-matter version bump for compatible change, meta-audit-enrichment-rom-v2.json only on breaking change. Constants and controls change only by human commit with NCI stamp.
